invoiceTemplateDescription: Choose how invoices look when downloaded or previewed by your team and clients.

visibilityDescription: Choose which sections appear in the client portal.

projectPlan.label: Project Plan (Tasks)
projectPlan.description: Shows the Projects section in the client portal.

ganttTimeline.label: Gantt / Timeline
ganttTimeline.description: Saved for when a Gantt/Timeline view ships in the client portal — no effect yet.

filesDocuments.label: Files & Documents
filesDocuments.description: Saved for when a standalone Files section ships in the client portal — no effect yet.

invoices.label: Invoices
invoices.description: Shows the Invoices section in the client portal.

feedbackForms.label: Feedback Forms
feedbackForms.description: Saved for when Feedback Forms ship in the client portal — no effect yet.

teamMembers.label: Team Members
teamMembers.description: Saved for when a client-facing Team Members page ships — no effect yet.

projectUpdates.label: Project Updates
projectUpdates.description: Saved for when Project Updates ship in the client portal — no effect yet.

chat.label: Chat
chat.description: Shows the Chats section in the client portal.

notificationsDescription: Choose what your team is notified about from client activity.

newMessage.label: New message
newMessage.description: Notify the team when a client sends a new message.

taskStatusChange.label: Task status change
taskStatusChange.description: Notify the team when a client-visible task changes status.

fileUploaded.label: File uploaded
fileUploaded.description: Notify the team when a client uploads a file.

clientUsers.bannerDescription: These settings define what a company's point of contact (POC) will be allowed to do once the client-facing portal supports it. For now, POC is a directory label only — nothing here is enforced anywhere yet.
clientUsers.selfManagementDescription: Let a company's own point of contact manage who from their company has portal access, instead of routing every add/remove through your team.

canAdd.label: Let POCs add company users
canAdd.description: A POC can invite a new teammate from their own company into the client portal.

canRemove.label: Let POCs remove company users
canRemove.description: A POC can revoke another user from their own company's portal access.

clientUsers.guardrailsTitle: Always true, regardless of the toggles above
clientUsers.guardrail1: A point of contact only ever sees and manages their own company's users — never another client's.
clientUsers.guardrail2: A point of contact never sees your internal team directory or gets organization-admin access.
clientUsers.guardrail3: Removing a company's only point of contact never deletes the company or its other users — it just leaves that company without one.

permissionTemplates.bannerDescription: Picking a template sets that permission level on every one of the company's current projects in one click — admins can still fine-tune access project by project afterward. Available when adding a company user or from Assign Projects on any existing user.

ticketingConfig.title: Ticket Statuses
ticketingConfig.description: Open, In Progress and Resolved always exist and can't be removed. Add team-defined statuses for workflows specific to your team — they show up in both the List and Board views of Ticketing.
ticketingConfig.defaultStatusesHint: These always exist and can't be removed.
